commands.name: verify-pinned-cargo-parent-observations
argv: import hashlib,json,pathlib,sys; p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); s=p.read_bytes(); expected='9e10e5fd5a95c196bc1f8403a3180d450b477a419abc4774316a12fbe3f40993'; assert hashlib.sha256(s).hexdigest()==expected, 'pinned Cargo observer helper changed'; ns=dict(__name__='ocore_cargo_observer_verifier',__file__=str(p)); exec(compile(s,str(p),'exec'),ns); result=ns['verify'](pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]),expected_worker_sha256=expected); output=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[3]); stream=output.open('x'); json.dump(result,stream,indent=2); stream.write(chr(10)); stream.close(); print(json.dumps(dict(output=str(output),parent_invocations=len(result['events']),observer_errors=len(result['observer_errors']),runtime_complete=False)))

commands.name: observe-whole-original-source-build
argv: import hashlib,json,pathlib,sys,subprocess; p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); s=p.read_bytes(); assert hashlib.sha256(s).hexdigest()=='c2c63dfee3f4cf71eabad0215bf803ed0aa322806a881444b0c1fff015759fc7', 'pinned Rust build inventory helper changed'; source,build,capture,rustc=sys.argv[2:]; host=next(l.removeprefix('host: ') for l in subprocess.check_output([rustc,'-vV'],text=True).splitlines() if l.startswith('host: ')); llvm=pathlib.Path(build)/'bootstrap'/host/'llvm/build'; args=[str(p),'--source',source,'--build',build,'--capture',capture,'--compile-commands',str(llvm/'compile_commands.json'),'--ninja',str(llvm/'build.ninja'),'--manifest',str(pathlib.Path(source)/'Cargo.toml'),'--metadata',str(pathlib.Path(build)/'bootstrap.toml'),'--metadata',str(pathlib.Path(build)/'cargo-parent-observer-verification.json'),'--output',str(pathlib.Path(build)/'full-source-build-inventory-observation.json')]; events=sorted((pathlib.Path(build)/'cargo-observer/events').glob('*.json')); records=[json.loads(e.read_bytes()) for e in events]; args.extend(a for e in events for a in ('--metadata',str(e))); args.extend(a for e in records if e.get('graph_query',dict()).get('status')=='recorded' for a in ('--cargo-unit-graph',e['graph_query']['stdout']['path'])); sys.argv=args; exec(compile(s,str(p),'exec'),dict(__name__='__main__',__file__=str(p)))

blockers: Rust has no interpreter runtime: stdlib and rustc/LLVM implementations, plus the programs rustc generates, must traverse O-core separately.
The pinned bootstrap preserves an existing RUSTC_WRAPPER as RUSTC_WRAPPER_REAL; every stage-specific compiler must satisfy the recorded LLVM version contract.
Bootstrap or CMake may select absolute C/C++ drivers; any such object bypass is incomplete until explicit target compiler configuration uses the wrappers.
Native OSTADIX std platform port, unwinding, TLS, threads, full ABI, wide arithmetic and floating-point are required on all three ISAs.
Cargo proc macros, build.rs scripts, C/C++ dependencies and the LLVM implementation require complete source-built dependency coverage.
Building rustc does not redirect its normal LLVM machine-code output through O-core; native generated-program lowering and compiler bootstrap witnesses remain required.

The whole original source build observation is diagnostic; exact observed parent Cargo commands and supplementary configured graphs do not establish payload roles or source/native-provider ownership by themselves.
RUSTC_STAGE alone does not identify the actual producer generation; the installed and source-built compilers, sysroots, host helpers, and payload output paths remain distinct.
The capture worker snapshot and Cargo observer/prepare/inventory helper bytes are independently digest-bound. Original legacy captures remain immutable and incomplete.
